A '''vacuum cleaner''' was a cleaning device. [[MR-9 housekeeping droid]]s were equipped with a retractable vacuum cleaner.<ref name="PM">''[[Planet of the Mists]]''</ref> The [[U2-C1-series housekeeping droid]] had powerful vacuum sweepers built into its arms.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
